references.text: The Lord warns that He will scatter Israel among the nations as punishment for disobedience, the same theme found in Deuteronomy 28:64.
Moses prophesies that the Lord will scatter the people among the nations where they will serve gods of wood and stone, identical to the warning in 28:64.
Nehemiah recalls God's warning through Moses about scattering the people among the nations due to unfaithfulness.
Jeremiah refers to the people serving foreign gods in a foreign land as fulfillment of the warning in Deuteronomy.
Ezekiel describes how the Lord scattered Israel among the nations, in accordance with the curse in Deuteronomy 28:64.
God swore to scatter Israel among the nations because of their idolatry, as prophesied in Deuteronomy 28.
The psalmist laments that God has scattered His people among the nations, a fulfillment of the curse.
Jesus prophesies that the Jews will be led away as captives to all nations, echoing the warning in Deuteronomy 28:64.
